newsitem.title: USA: Andrew directors authorize share buyback.
newsitem.headline: Andrew directors authorize share buyback.

text.p: Andrew Corp said Wednesday its directors authorized the repurchase of up to five percent or five million of the company's common shares.
The shares will be bought back in the open market and in private transactions, the company said in a statement.
The shares will be availabe for employee stock programs and general corporate purposes.
Andrew said it will fund the purchases through cash and cash equivalents on hand and through the company's line of credit.
Andrew designs, makes and sells specialized antennas and transmission lines used in telecommunications systems.
Shares of Andrew closed on Tuesday at 23-5/8.
